INFERENCE: when price, policy and revisions are this aligned, the higher-rate trend persists and the SR3 2027 peak near 4.755 is a premature fade, not a terminal. UNKNOWN: the next official US inflation/labor print and any non-linear credit accident (the 2023-02 analog). Ride continuation in SOFR, do not fade USDCAD or AU housing as if they were reversal signals.
